### New

- Local-project history sync now covers more code agents.
- Reworked the sync pipeline and status display: opening a conversation now pulls the latest content for that thread on demand, and the state is easier to read at a glance.

### Fixes and Improvements

- Applied a temporary workaround for the mobile composer overlapping when too much content sits below it.
- Fixed an occasional bad state in Codex Goal runs.
